d: Extremely long, flowing pale blonde hair with straight bangs and a small tuft atop the head frames a youthful, mature face with narrow, almond-shaped lime-green eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white, short-skirted dress with green trim, a large yellow bow at the chest, and a red-lined white cape draped over the shoulders. White thigh-high boots with pink gem accents complete the ensemble, while the character holds a tall golden staff topped with a green and pink crystalline ornament. Floating green diamond-shaped crystals hover in the air around the figure.
